laws.rule: Under Busan's ordinance on creating a smoke-free environment, the area within 10 metres of a taxi stand became a smoke-free zone on 1 September 2025, with a fine of KRW 50,000 (about A$53.13, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = KRW 941.07) starting in December 2025. A news report says bus stops and subway station entrances were already covered. The city's own page could not be read, so confirm with Busan Metropolitan City.

Busan Metropolitan City can designate outdoor places as smoke-free under the National Health Promotion Act. The ordinance lists the kinds of place it can cover: city parks, bus stops and taxi stands, beaches, riverside walking paths, busy streets and tourist or shopping areas, school routes, the area within 10 metres of urban rail exits, crossings (5 metres), traditional markets and public toilets. The exact designated sites are set by notice and marked by signs, so follow the signs. The fine is KRW 50,000 (about A$53.13, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = KRW 941.07).

Haeundae District's beach ordinance bans these acts on its beaches: going into the sea from 30 minutes after sunset until 30 minutes before sunrise outside the official swimming season, unless the district head allows it; fishing on the sand; and driving a vehicle onto the beach unless the district head allows it. It also repeats the banned acts in the national Beach Use and Management Act (not read here). A repeat offender can be refused entry or ordered to leave.
laws.penalty_signal: Fines for the night-swimming and sand-fishing rules are in Annex 3 of the ordinance, which could not be read from the text; the amounts are not confirmed here.

laws.rule: Haeundae District can designate city parks, beaches, bus stops, riverside paths, the Green Railway path, petrol stations and school routes as smoke-free. The designated sites are set by notice and marked by signs.
laws.penalty_signal: KRW 50,000 under the Busan city ordinance already listed here (A$53.13, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = KRW 941.07); the district ordinance points to the city fine.
